card.name: Ending of interleukin before a number
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" of "interleukin" right before a hyphen and a number, as in interleukin-2 or interleukin-6. Also fires on a few other word pieces before a hyphen, such as Aminosyn-PF.

modes.label: Interleukin names
modes.description: The ending "in" of interleukin just before a hyphen and a number.

modes.label: Other hyphenated names
modes.description: Word pieces inside a name that is followed by a hyphen, such as Aminosyn-PF or Abd al-Sayyid.

card.plain: It marks the end of the word interleukin when a hyphen and a number like -2 or -6 come next.
